lyrics: Private briefing, ten a.m. The   doors are sealed up tight.
Talking bank failures and a   coming financial blight.
The cameras are all gone. The   public doesn't know.
Just a roomful of servants watching the cancer grow.
They nod their heads so gravely, they   furrow up their brows, and then they
slip out to the lobby to   honor silent vows.
Not to the constitution, not   to the folks back home,
but to the little ticker buzzing
on their private phone.
BUY THE FEAR,   SELL THE NEWS,
WHILE THE COUNTRY SINGS THE    WORKING-CLASS BLUES.
IT'S THE STOCK ACT, BABY,   A SHAM WITHOUT A SPINE.
YOUR NATIONAL CRISIS
IS MY BOTTOM LINE!
Nancy's buying options on   the next big tech IPO,
while she's writing regulations   to help the money
grow. A senator sells his bank stock   while the system starts to crack,
then buys a ton of defense shares   for the next surprise attack.
A deadly pandemic's coming?   Better dump that travel stock.
Buy up Pfizer and Moderna,   just racing 'gainst the clock.
It's not red, it's not blue, it's   the only color they see.
The color of fresh money   made by you
and me.
